```{=html}
<svg class="aav-fig" viewBox="0 0 1000 400" shape-rendering="geometricPrecision" role="img"
     aria-label="Inside a transduced hepatocyte, a capsid that never reached the nucleus is tagged with ubiquitin and fed to the proteasome, which cuts it into peptides. The peptides are loaded onto MHC class I and displayed on the cell surface, where a capsid-specific CD8 T cell recognises the complex and releases perforin and granzyme, killing the cell and taking its expression with it.">
  <defs>
    <marker id="aav-ah-ctl" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="var(--aav-muted)"/>
    </marker>
    <marker id="aav-ah-ctl-kill" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="var(--aav-tcell)"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- transduced hepatocyte; its right edge is the plasma membrane -->
  <rect x="16" y="70" width="620" height="310" rx="24"
        fill="var(--aav-paper)" stroke="var(--aav-ink)" stroke-width="4"/>
  <text class="aav-fig-note" x="36" y="96">transduced hepatocyte</text>

  <!-- the nucleus the capsid never reached -->
  <ellipse cx="112" cy="150" rx="62" ry="42" fill="var(--aav-nucleoplasm)" stroke="var(--aav-muted)" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text class="aav-fig-note aav-fig-mid" x="112" y="155">nucleus</text>
  <g transform="translate(112 268)">
    <path d="M0,-24 L20.8,-12 L20.8,12 L0,24 L-20.8,12 L-20.8,-12 Z" fill="var(--aav-vector)"/>
  </g>
  <path d="M112 240 V 206" stroke="var(--aav-traffic)" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 4"
        fill="none" marker-end="url(#aav-ah-ctl)"/>
  <path d="M88 224 H136" stroke="var(--aav-alarm)" stroke-width="4.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <text class="aav-fig-note aav-fig-mid" x="112" y="312">never arrives &#8212; most do not</text>

  <!-- ubiquitin tag -->
  <g fill="var(--aav-traffic)">
    <circle cx="140" cy="248" r="5.5"/><circle cx="152" cy="256" r="5.5"/><circle cx="162" cy="266" r="5.5"/>
  </g>
  <text class="aav-fig-note" x="146" y="238">ubiquitin</text>

  <!-- proteasome -->
  <g fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="var(--aav-muted)" stroke-width="2">
    <rect x="232" y="238" width="90" height="14" rx="7"/>
    <rect x="232" y="255" width="90" height="14" rx="7"/>
    <rect x="232" y="272" width="90" height="14" rx="7"/>
    <rect x="232" y="289" width="90" height="14" rx="7"/>
  </g>
  <path d="M277 236 V 305" stroke="var(--aav-rule)" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text class="aav-fig-lead aav-fig-mid" x="277" y="226">proteasome</text>
  <path d="M180 268 H226" stroke="var(--aav-muted)" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#aav-ah-ctl)"/>

  <!-- peptides -->
  <g fill="var(--aav-vector)">
    <rect x="360" y="244" width="15" height="9" rx="2"/>
    <rect x="384" y="258" width="15" height="9" rx="2"/>
    <rect x="358" y="274" width="15" height="9" rx="2"/>
    <rect x="386" y="288" width="15" height="9" rx="2"/>
  </g>
  <text class="aav-fig-note aav-fig-mid" x="380" y="322">capsid peptides</text>
  <path d="M328 268 H352" stroke="var(--aav-muted)" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#aav-ah-ctl)"/>

  <!-- MHC class I on the membrane, groove facing out -->
  <path d="M414 262 C 500 244, 560 236, 610 234" fill="none" stroke="var(--aav-muted)"
        stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#aav-ah-ctl)"/>
  <path d="M636 250 L690 232 M636 250 L690 268" stroke="var(--aav-antibody)" stroke-width="5"
        stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <rect x="678" y="242" width="16" height="9" rx="2" fill="var(--aav-vector)"/>
  <text class="aav-fig-lead aav-fig-end" x="626" y="176" fill="var(--aav-antibody)">MHC class I</text>
  <text class="aav-fig-note aav-fig-end" x="626" y="192">shows what the cell contains</text>

  <!-- CD8 T cell with its receptor engaging the complex -->
  <circle cx="800" cy="250" r="84" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="var(--aav-tcell)" stroke-width="3.5"/>
  <text class="aav-fig-lead aav-fig-mid" x="806" y="246" fill="var(--aav-tcell)">CD8&#8314;</text>
  <text class="aav-fig-note aav-fig-mid" x="806" y="266" fill="var(--aav-tcell)">T cell</text>
  <path d="M718 228 H698 V 272 H718" fill="none" stroke="var(--aav-tcell)" stroke-width="4"/>
  <text class="aav-fig-note" x="706" y="164" fill="var(--aav-tcell)">T-cell receptor</text>

  <!-- the kill -->
  <path d="M744 320 C 700 352, 640 362, 590 356" fill="none" stroke="var(--aav-tcell)"
        stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 4" marker-end="url(#aav-ah-ctl-kill)"/>
  <text class="aav-fig-lead" x="756" y="352" fill="var(--aav-tcell)">perforin, granzyme</text>
  <text class="aav-fig-lead aav-fig-mid" x="330" y="360">apoptosis &#8212; expression lost</text>

  <!-- when this happens -->
  <rect x="700" y="58" width="284" height="60" rx="10" fill="var(--aav-paper)" stroke="var(--aav-rule)" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <text class="aav-fig-lead" x="718" y="82">4 to 8 weeks after infusion</text>
  <text class="aav-fig-note" x="718" y="100">ALT and AST rise as expression falls</text>
</svg>
```
